name: Central Shopping Research & Affiliate Bridge

allFrontQueensCheck.rule: Every front request must classify shopping/procurement needs during Queens. NONE continues the normal app pipeline with zero commerce calls. OPTIONAL/REQUIRED routes only the matched need to its domain lane.
allFrontQueensCheck.hourlyControl: Reuse the existing processTaskQueue physical trigger and perform one logical hourly due check; never create a separate browser crawl timer.

APP_TRAVEL.domainSeparation: TICKET/PASS/RESERVATION use official Travel live/booking lane; do not mix venue/hotel/restaurant reviews into BRG_032.

APP_BIBLE.highStakesRule: Doctrinal/scriptural claims remain official/canonical-source evidence; shopping reviews never establish scripture facts.

APP_ANALYZER.activationRule: Only when the analysis target is explicitly a physical product.

nonPhysicalOrSupportApps.APP_ARSENAL: DIGITAL_TOOL/SERVICE_SUBSCRIPTION uses tool/service evaluation lane; physical tool only if explicit.
nonPhysicalOrSupportApps.APP_NBLAB: DIGITAL_RESEARCH_RESOURCE uses research lane; physical reference/lab tool only if explicit.
nonPhysicalOrSupportApps.APP_DRYSEED: Check is required but defaults NONE; this internal app never starts affiliate routing by itself.
nonPhysicalOrSupportApps.APP_QUEENS: Check is required but defaults NONE; it receives/normalizes research tasks rather than inventing shopping needs.
nonPhysicalOrSupportApps.APP_SEED: Check is required but defaults NONE; it qualifies evidence and never creates a product need by itself.
nonPhysicalOrSupportApps.APP_NEW: Classify domain first, then register an explicit shopping-need profile before provider routing.

futureAppRule: NO_IMPLICIT_PROVIDER_ADOPTION. Every front may run the Queens need check, but a new app may enter BRG_032/provider comparison only after its canonical APP_ID and commerce-domain profile are registered.
